Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Thank you for a long partnership on the bearing bracket; we know the past months have been demanding for your team, and we value the price discipline you have kept. Our quality team has shared the scorecard, and we would like to turn it into a joint improvement plan with a clear quality commitment. In return we offer stable conditions on a growing volume, and we will pay your invoices on time.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our recent quality notifications on this part average 17197 ppm (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 63.5% (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

The quality record figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. But we like the higher volume and your promise to actually pay on time, since late payments hurt us. So we can drop the price to 46.50 EUR and agree to a 2500 ppm target. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We also offer an alternative with a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

key_points: Quality case on the sole-sourced bearing bracket: the main value is a tight ppm commitment (must be at most the middle option; aim for the tightest) and a meaningful chargeback, not a price cut.

The supplier is distressed and under bank supervision and cannot sign a margin cut. Its price is far below the fallback (second source is much dearer plus tooling), so walking away is very costly for us.
Payment days are fixed, so cash cannot be traded. Acknowledge our late payments in words and commit to paying on time.
Lead with checkable quality records (part notifications, scorecard ppm, delivery) and the rising forecast. Hold the power-price fall as a later fresh fact.
Do not cite peak-index arguments, the stale health data, the rival quote or the price history; they argue its side or are not checkable.
plan.stance_why: Sole source, distressed supplier with a high squeeze risk, price already well below the only alternative, and a quality_first goal where defects outweigh cents. Aim to hold the price roughly flat and win the ppm commitment and chargeback.

levers.why: Part-specific, checkable defect evidence that justifies a tight ppm commitment and a chargeback.

argument.sentence: Our recent quality notifications on this part average 17197 ppm (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747).
argument.note: 4 supplier-caused complaints on this part in the last 12 months (leakage at test, missing marking, porosity, wrong material certificate); EUR 300 recharged; 1 without a closed 8D. Per-lot ppm is jumpy (KNOWN_ISSUES 10): the scorecard's rolling ppm is the fairer figure.

levers.why: Checkable on-time record from the red scorecard; frames the joint improvement plan.

argument.sentence: Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 63.5% (sc:70140@2026Q3).
argument.note: Rolling 12 months to 2026-09-30: 63.5% on time against the requested date (73.1% against its own confirmed date); target 95%; peers' median 84.6%; class C red. A year earlier 71.7%.

levers.why: A rising forecast is a positive offer and planning security for its banks.

argument.sentence: Our demand forecast for this part has risen 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
argument.note: Snapshot 2026-09: 15930 for the next 12 months against 13280 ordered in the last 12 months (requested dates); shared with suppliers: True. More volume is worth more to it.

levers.why: Fresh scorecard ppm figure to back holding the tight ppm target.

argument.sentence: Your rolling scorecard shows 2376 ppm defects (sc:70140@2026Q3).
argument.note: Rolling 12 months to 2026-09-30: 2376 ppm from 12 complaints; peers' median 457.0 ppm; 8D reports overdue 0. A year earlier 3075 ppm.

levers.why: Checkable twelve-month power fall that offsets its steel and labour claims.

argument.sentence: Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
argument.note: PPI-D351 (Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution): -3.7% 12 months (2025-08 to 2026-08); 6% of the part's cost, so about -0.22% on the price.

levers.why: Confirms the current price level as the basis for a stable price.

argument.sentence: Our latest orders for this part were all at EUR 45.15 per unit (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
argument.note: What we pay now: [45.15, 45.15, 45.15] per unit (2026-08-21 to 2026-09-21); anchors any increase.

levers.why: Our formal escalation letter, if it disputes the quality situation.

argument.sentence: We refer to our letter "Escalation: delivery and quality performance" (doc:20260921-70140-P11).
argument.note: letter 2026-09-21 by Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Supplier Quality: To Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. your rolling 12-month scorecard (sc:70140@2026Q3) is red: on-time delivery 63.5 %, 2376 ppm, 0 overdue 8D reports. We expect a binding improvement plan for Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) and will discuss quality commitments and cost recovery. Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Supplier Quality

trades.why: Defects cost most, and a supplier keen to repair its standing may accept a tight target without a premium.
Test a meaningful chargeback; it can be eased in a later round as a trade.
Fallback if the tightest target blocks agreement; still well inside the must-have.
Lower the chargeback in exchange for holding price and the ppm target.

sup:70140.opening_paragraph: Thank you for a long partnership on the bearing bracket; we know the past months have been demanding for your team, and we value the price discipline you have kept. Our quality team has shared the scorecard, and we would like to turn it into a joint improvement plan with a clear quality commitment. In return we offer stable conditions on a growing volume, and we will pay your invoices on time.
watch_for: Claims of steel and labour rises: answer with proportion and the power fall, not a cut.
A request for faster payment: it is fixed, so offer on-time payment only.
Pushback on the tight ppm target: move to the middle option rather than a looser one.
A final offer: accept it if it meets the must-have and beats the fallback.
Signs of liquidity collapse or delivery risk around the year-end shutdown.

risks: Squeezing price risks supply failure at a sole source with supplier-owned tooling; the fallback is much dearer and needs tooling.
Our own late payments weaken complaints about delivery; acknowledge them first.
Too harsh a chargeback could strain its margin limits and stall approval up the ladder.
Evidence on its cost base is thin (no should-cost for the bracket).
